extracted.intended_audience: Users and developers of GAP (computational algebra system); mathematicians and programmers working with relations, orderings, and magmas
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP functions, attributes, operations and properties concerning binary relations, equivalence relations, orderings, and magmas. Includes constructors, closure operations, predicates, and examples for using these features in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Successors
rubrics_metrics.description: The Successors of a relation is the adjacency list representation of the relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists are ordered as the elements according to the sorted order of the underlying set of R. Each list consists of the images of the element whose index is the same as the list with the underlying set in sorted order. Example given with GAP output.

rubrics_metrics.name: DegreeOfBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the size of the underlying domain of the binary relation R. This is most natural when working with a binary relation on points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute example: DegreeOfBinaryRelation(r1) returns 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialOrderOfHasseDiagram
rubrics_metrics.description: is the partial order associated with the Hasse Diagram HD i.e. the partial order generated by the reflexive and transitive closure of HD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute mapping a Hasse diagram to its partial order.

rubrics_metrics.name: BinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a list of n lists, each containing elements from the set {1, . . . , n}, this function constructs a binary relation such that 1 is related to list[1], 2 to list[2] and so on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two forms: checking (BinaryRelationOnPoints) and NC version (BinaryRelationOnPointsNC) which skips the validity check. Example: BinaryRelationOnPoints([[1,2],[2],[3]]) constructs a relation on 3 points.

rubrics_metrics.name: RandomBinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: creates a relation on points with degree degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructor for random binary relations on points with given degree.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsBinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: return the relation on points represented by general relation rel, transformation trans or permutation perm. If rel is already a binary relation on points then rel is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructs an isomorphic relation on points where points are indices of underlying domain in sorted order. Examples included converting a Transformation or permutation to Binary Relation on points.

rubrics_metrics.name: ReflexiveClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: is the smallest binary relation containing the binary relation R which is reflexive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This closure inherits the properties symmetric and transitive from R. E.g., if R is symmetric then its reflexive closure is also symmetric.

rubrics_metrics.name: SymmetricClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: is the smallest binary relation containing the binary relation R which is symmetric.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This closure inherits the properties reflexive and transitive from R. E.g., if R is reflexive then its symmetric closure is also reflexive.

rubrics_metrics.name: TransitiveClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: is the smallest binary relation containing the binary relation R which is transitive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TransitiveClosureBinaryRelation is a modified version of the Floyd–Warshall method for all-pairs shortest-paths; its asymptotic runtime is O(n^3) where n is the size of the vertex set. It assumes an arbitrary but fixed ordering of the vertex set.

rubrics_metrics.name: HasseDiagramBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: is the smallest relation contained in the partial order partial-order whose reflexive and transitive closure is equal to partial-order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation constructing the Hasse diagram relation from a partial order.

rubrics_metrics.name: StronglyConnectedComponents
rubrics_metrics.description: returns an equivalence relation on the vertices of the binary relation R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation that computes SCCs and returns them as an equivalence relation.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialOrderByOrderingFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: constructs a partial order whose elements are from the domain dom and are ordered using the ordering function orderfunc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ordering function must be a binary function returning a boolean value; if it does not describe a partial order then fail is returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equivalence relation (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: An equivalence relation E over the set X is a relation on X which is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An equivalence relation induces a partition (set of mutually disjoint subsets whose union is X); if (x,y) in E then x and y are in the same block of the partition.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceRelationByPartition
rubrics_metrics.description: constructs the equivalence relation over the set domain which induces the partition represented by list. The representation includes only the non-trivial blocks (non-singleton classes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two forms: checked (EquivalenceRelationByPartition) and NC version (EquivalenceRelationByPartitionNC) which does not check pairwise exclusivity or that elements are in the domain. list is a list of lists representing nontrivial blocks; singletons are ignored. Example shown constructing an equivalence relation from partition on Domain([1..10]).

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceRelationByRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the smallest equivalence relation containing the binary relation rel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation forming equivalence closure of an arbitrary binary relation.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceRelationByPairs
rubrics_metrics.description: return the smallest equivalence relation on the domain D such that every pair in elms is in the relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two forms: checked and NC (EquivalenceRelationByPairsNC) which doesn't check that elms are in domain D.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceRelationByProperty
rubrics_metrics.description: creates an equivalence relation on domain whose only defining datum is that of having the property property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructor based on a property predicate that partitions the domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceRelationPartition
rubrics_metrics.description: returns a list of lists of elements of the underlying set of the equivalence relation equiv: the non-singleton equivalence classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows describing small equivalences on infinite sets. This is the main attribute for equivalence relations in GAP since only non-singleton blocks are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfEquivalenceRelationPartition
rubrics_metrics.description: is a set of generating pairs for the equivalence relation equiv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This set is not unique; equiv is the smallest equivalence relation over the underlying set containing the generating pairs.

rubrics_metrics.name: JoinEquivalenceRelations
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the smallest equivalence relation containing both the equivalence relations equiv1 and equiv2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to join two equivalence relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: MeetEquivalenceRelations
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the intersection of the two equivalence relations equiv1 and equiv2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation computing the meet (intersection) of equivalence relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEquivalenceClass
rubrics_metrics.description: returns true if the object obj is an equivalence class, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An equivalence class is a special category of objects in GAP, not just a list of elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceClassRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the equivalence relation of which C is a class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute mapping a class object back to its equivalence relation.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceClasses
rubrics_metrics.description: returns a list of all equivalence classes of the equivalence relation rel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different methods may yield lists in different orders; equality of relations does not imply equality of their EquivalenceClasses lists. Example given.

rubrics_metrics.name: EquivalenceClassOfElement
rubrics_metrics.description: return the equivalence class of elt in the binary relation rel, where elt is an element (i.e., a pair) of the domain of rel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two forms: checked and NC (EquivalenceClassOfElementNC) which does not check that elt is in the domain. Example shown EquivalenceClassOfElement(er,3) => {3}.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: returns true if and only if the object ord is an ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter/predicate identifying ordering objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrderingsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: for a family fam, returns the family of all orderings on elements of fam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute enumerating orderings over a given family.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrderingByLessThanFunctionNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Called with two arguments, returns the ordering on the elements of the family fam according to the LessThanFunction value given by lt, where lt is a function that takes two arguments in fam and returns true or false. Called with three arguments, also sets properties from list l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NC suffix: does not check whether fam and lt are compatible or that listed properties in l are satisfied. Example given constructing an ordering based on length of words.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrderingByLessThanOrEqualFunctionNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Called with two arguments, returns the ordering on the elements of fam according to the LessThanOrEqualFunction value given by lteq; with three arguments, sets given properties l. The NC form does not check compatibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Similar to OrderingByLessThanFunctionNC but uses a less-than-or-equal predicate; note warnings about lack of checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWellFoundedOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns true iff the ordering is well founded (admits no infinite descending chains).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normally this property is set at time of creation; there is no general method to check well-foundedness.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTotalOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns true iff the ordering is total (any two elements are comparable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normally set at creation; no general method to check totality.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsIncomparableUnder
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on the family of el1 and el2, returns true if el1 != el2 and IsLessThanUnder(ord,el1,el2) and IsLessThanUnder(ord,el2,el1) are both false.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to test incomparability under an ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: FamilyForOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns the family of elements that the ordering ord compares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute to recover the domain/family of an ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: LessThanFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns a function f which takes two elements el1, el2 in FamilyForOrdering(ord) and returns true if el1 is strictly less than el2 with respect to ord, false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute providing the strict comparison function implementing the ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: LessThanOrEqualFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns a function that takes two elements el1, el2 in FamilyForOrdering(ord) and returns true if el1 is less than or equal to el2 with respect to ord, false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute providing the non-strict comparison function.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLessThanUnder
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on the family of el1 and el2, returns true if el1 is (strictly) less than el2 with respect to ord, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation for direct comparison under an ordering. Examples given.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLessThanOrEqualUnder
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on the family of el1 and el2, returns true if el1 is less than or equal to el2 with respect to ord, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation for non-strict comparison under an ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsOrderingOnFamilyOfAssocWords
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord, returns true if ord is an ordering over a family of associative words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate specialized to orderings over associative word families (free semigroup/monoid elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTranslationInvariantOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on a family of associative words, returns true iff the ordering is translation invariant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translation invariant means IsLessThanUnder(ord,u,v) implies for any a,b in X*, IsLessThanUnder(ord,a*u*b,a*v*b). Property specific to orderings on associative words.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsReductionOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on a family of associative words, returns true iff the ordering is a reduction ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A reduction ordering is well founded and translation invariant.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrderingOnGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on a family of associative words, returns a list in which the generators are considered (ordering of generators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: if a weight is associated to each generator this list may not be the simple ordering of generators; referenced in WeightLexOrdering example.

rubrics_metrics.name: LexicographicOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: LexicographicOrdering(D[, gens]) returns the lexicographic ordering on elements of D (free semigroup/monoid or their element families). Optional gens specifies ordering of generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If gens omitted default ordering used. Examples illustrate IsLessThanUnder results.

rubrics_metrics.name: ShortLexOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: ShortLexOrdering(D[, gens]) returns the shortlex ordering on elements of D. Optional gens specifies ordering of generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shortlex: compare by length then lexicographically. Examples and IsShortLexOrdering predicate exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsShortLexOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord of a family of associative words, returns true iff ord is a shortlex ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate with examples shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: WeightLexOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: WeightLexOrdering(D, gens, wt) returns the weightlex ordering on elements of D with ordering on generators and given weights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: gens can be generator list or positions; wt is list of weights. Examples show OrderingOnGenerators and WeightOfGenerators attributes and comparison behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWeightLexOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: for an ordering ord on a family of associative words, returns true iff ord is a weightlex ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate to test weightlex property.

rubrics_metrics.name: WeightOfGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: for a weightlex ordering ord, returns a list giving the weight of each letter of the alphabet used for weightlex ordering with respect to OrderingOnGenerators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute returns list of weights as given at creation. Example shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: BasicWreathProductOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: BasicWreathProductOrdering(D[, gens]) returns the basic wreath product ordering on elements of D. Optional gens gives ordering of generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation returning basic wreath product ordering; examples show comparison results.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBasicWreathProductOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: specifies whether an ordering is a basic wreath product ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate with examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: WreathProductOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: WreathProductOrdering(D[, gens], levels) returns the wreath product ordering on elements of D with ordering on generators as given and levels specifying levels for generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If gens omitted default ordering used. levels is a list of levels for generators. Examples show IsLessThanUnder and LevelsOfGenerators.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWreathProductOrdering
rubrics_metrics.description: specifies whether an ordering is a wreath product ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate referring to WreathProductOrdering.

rubrics_metrics.name: LevelsOfGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: for a wreath product ordering ord, returns the levels of the generators as given at creation (with respect to OrderingOnGenerators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute returning the levels list. Example shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagma
rubrics_metrics.description: A magma in GAP is a domain M with (not necessarily associative) multiplication *: M × M → M. IsMagma(obj) returns true if obj is a magma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category predicate defining magma objects in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagmaWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: A magma-with-one in GAP is a magma M with an operation ^0 (or One) that yields the identity of M. IsMagmaWithOne(obj) returns true iff obj is such an object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A magma-with-one contains a unique multiplicatively neutral element e satisfying e*m = m = m*e for all m in M. One(M) computes the identity. Notes about magmas that may contain neutral elements but not be in the category IsMagmaWithOne.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagmaWithInversesIfNonzero
rubrics_metrics.description: An object in this category is a magma-with-one M with an operation ^-1: M \ Z → M \ Z mapping each element of M \ Z to its inverse, where Z is either empty or consists exactly of one element of M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes category intended mainly for division rings; typically Z is the zero element if present. Explains relationship to other categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagmaWithInverses
rubrics_metrics.description: A magma-with-inverses in GAP is a magma-with-one M with an operation ^-1: M → M that maps each element m to its inverse m^-1. IsMagmaWithInverses(obj) returns true iff obj is such.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes on trivial magmas and relations between categories (magma-with-one, magma-with-inverses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Magma
rubrics_metrics.description: Magma([Fam,] gens) returns the magma M generated by elements in list gens, i.e., the closure of gens under multiplication *.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family Fam can be given as first argument; required if gens is empty. Function creates magma from generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: MagmaWithOne([Fam,] gens) returns the magma-with-one M generated by gens, i.e., closure under multiplication and One.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family Fam required if gens empty (trivial magma case).

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaWithInverses
rubrics_metrics.description: MagmaWithInverses([Fam,] gens) returns the magma-with-inverses M generated by gens, i.e., closure under multiplication, One, and Inverse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family Fam required if gens empty.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaByGenerators / MagmaWithOneByGenerators / MagmaWithInversesByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Underlying operations for Magma, MagmaWithOne, MagmaWithInverses that form magmas from generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placeholders for method-installable operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submagma / SubmagmaNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Submagma(D, gens) returns the magma generated by elements in gens with parent domain D. SubmagmaNC does same but does not check that gens lie in D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NC variants skip checks for membership.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubmagmaWithOne / SubmagmaWithOneNC
rubrics_metrics.description: SubmagmaWithOne(D, gens) returns the magma-with-one generated by gens with parent D. NC variant skips membership checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As above but for magma-with-one.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubmagmaWithInverses / SubmagmaWithInversesNC
rubrics_metrics.description: SubmagmaWithInverses(D, gens) returns the magma-with-inverses generated by gens with parent D. NC skips membership checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As above but for magma-with-inverses.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsMagma
rubrics_metrics.description: For a collection C whose elements form a magma, AsMagma(C) returns this magma; otherwise fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute that promotes a collection to a magma if possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsSubmagma
rubrics_metrics.description: Let D be a domain and C a collection. If C is a subset of D that forms a magma then AsSubmagma(D,C) returns this magma with parent D; otherwise fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to coerce subset into submagma with parent domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagmaWithZeroAdjoined
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if the magma M was created using InjectionZeroMagma or MagmaWithZeroAdjoined and thus has a zero adjoined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate detecting magmas that were built by adjoining a multiplicative zero element.

rubrics_metrics.name: InjectionZeroMagma / MagmaWithZeroAdjoined
rubrics_metrics.description: InjectionZeroMagma(M) returns an embedding from magma M into a new magma formed from M by adjoining a single new element which is the multiplicative zero. MagmaWithZeroAdjoined is shorthand for Range(InjectionZeroMagma(M)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The new magma forms a family of elements in category IsMultiplicativeElementWithZero and satisfies IsMagmaWithZeroAdjoined. Example and methods to recover embedding (UnderlyingInjectionZeroMagma) shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingInjectionZeroMagma
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingInjectionZeroMagma(M) returns the embedding used to create the magma with zero adjoined M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute to recover mapping used to adjoin zero; example shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaByMultiplicationTable
rubrics_metrics.description: For a square matrix A with n rows and entries in [1..n], MagmaByMultiplicationTable(A) returns a magma M with multiplication * defined by A so that mi * mj = mk where k = A[i][j].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ordering of elements is m1 < m2 < ... < mn so MagmaElement(M,i) accesses elements. Recommended only for small magmas; example provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaWithOneByMultiplicationTable
rubrics_metrics.description: Like MagmaByMultiplicationTable but returns a magma-with-one if the magma described by A has an identity; otherwise returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks identity existence; example shows fail when no identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaWithInversesByMultiplicationTable
rubrics_metrics.description: Like MagmaByMultiplicationTable but returns a magma-with-inverses if each element in the magma described by A has an inverse; otherwise returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows success and failure cases depending on presence of inverses.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaElement
rubrics_metrics.description: For a magma M and positive integer i, MagmaElement(M,i) returns the i-th element of M with respect to ordering <. Returns fail if M has fewer than i elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access magma element by index given canonical ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicationTable
rubrics_metrics.description: For a list elms of elements that form a magma M, MultiplicationTable returns a square matrix A with A[i][j] = k iff elms[i] * elms[j] = elms[k]. For a magma M, returns multiplication table w.r.t. sorted list of elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Matrix can be used with MagmaByMultiplicationTable to construct isomorphic magma. Examples provided demonstrating round-trip.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfMagma
rubrics_metrics.description: is a list gens of elements of magma M that generates M as a magma (closure under multiplication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For free magma, each generator can also be accessed using . operator (GeneratorsOfDomain).

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfMagmaWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: is a list gens of elements of the magma-with-one M that generates M as a magma-with-one (closure under multiplication and One).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators accessible via . operator for free magma-with-one.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfMagmaWithInverses
rubrics_metrics.description: is a list gens of elements of the magma-with-inverses M that generates M as a magma-with-inverses (closure under multiplication and taking inverses).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute describing generating set for magma-with-inverses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralizer
rubrics_metrics.description: For an element elm of magma M, Centralizer(M,elm) returns the domain of elements m ∈ M that commute with elm. For submagma S, Centralizer(M,S) returns domain of elements commuting with all s in S. For a class, Centralizer(class) returns centralizer of Representative(class).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation returns centralizer as a domain; examples shown for groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centre / Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Centre(M) returns the centre of magma M: elements m ∈ M that commute and associate with all elements of M (satisfy listed associativity/commutativity equalities). Center is synonym.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For associative magmas, Centre(M) = Centralizer(M,M). Centre of a magma is always commutative; when installing Centre methods, set IsCommutative of result to true.

rubrics_metrics.name: Idempotents
rubrics_metrics.description: Idempotents(M) returns the set of elements of M which are their own squares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute enumerating idempotent elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAssociative
rubrics_metrics.description: A collection M with multiplication * is associative if for all a,b,c in M, (a*b)*c = a*(b*c). IsAssociative(M) tests this property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associative magma = semigroup; associative magma-with-one = monoid; associative magma-with-inverses = group.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCentral
rubrics_metrics.description: IsCentral(M,obj) returns true if obj (element or magma) commutes with all elements in M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to test centrality relative to a magma.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCommutative / IsAbelian
rubrics_metrics.description: A collection M with multiplication * is commutative if for all a,b in M, a*b = b*a. IsCommutative(M) or IsAbelian(M) test this property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: commutativity of addition in additive structures is tested with IsAdditivelyCommutative.

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicativeNeutralElement
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the element e in magma M such that e*m = m = m*e for all m ∈ M if such an element exists; otherwise fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A magma that is not in category IsMagmaWithOne can nevertheless have a multiplicative neutral element; in that case e is not obtainable via One(M).

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicativeZero / IsMultiplicativeZero
rubrics_metrics.description: MultiplicativeZero(M) returns the multiplicative zero z in M such that z*m = m*z = z for all m in M. IsMultiplicativeZero(M,z) returns true if z equals the multiplicative zero of M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show cases where MultiplicativeZero returns fail or a particular Transformation element.

rubrics_metrics.name: SquareRoots
rubrics_metrics.description: SquareRoots(M,elm) is the proper set of all elements r in magma M such that r * r = elm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to compute square roots within magma.

rubrics_metrics.name: TrivialSubmagmaWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: TrivialSubmagmaWithOne(M) is the magma-with-one that has the identity of M as its only element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute returning trivial submagma consisting only of the identity element.
